subject: Veridian exec sponsor short-brief: propose alternate slot
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Olson <daniel.olson@veridian.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 09:14 AM PDT
Subject: Veridian exec sponsor short-brief: propose alternate slot

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to do a focused sponsor-level walkthrough that highlights how Redwood can reduce per-token cost and lock in low-latency behavior for Veridian's field automation use case.

Quick proposal: 30-minute session that includes
- 10 min: brief exec-level context & business outcomes (VP/CIO)
- 15 min: live demo of the topology and failover behavior
- 5 min: next steps & mutual action items

Would Veridian prefer a short 15-minute handshake with a VP + 15 full demo minutes, or a 30-minute block with your CIO present? To make this concrete: are either of these windows possible for the week of Apr 12?

- Tue Apr 13, 10:30–11:00 PT
- Tue Apr 13, 14:30–15:00 PT

I've attached a draft agenda (veridian_demo_agenda_v1.pdf). If one of the slots works, we can lock the calendar and I will request a brief pre-brief with your operations lead so we have the right telemetry ready.

If scheduling is tight we can also flip coverage; Ben can cover a portion at the product level and Rachel can handle commercial questions.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

From: Daniel Olson <daniel.olson@veridian.com>

Cc: Veridian Executive Ops <execops@veridian.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 11:02 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Veridian exec sponsor short-brief: propose alternate slot

Mina —

Appreciate the clear outline. Our VP of Infrastructure (Asha Patel) is the ideal sponsor for this; the CIO (Tom Li) would be great if available but likely tight. For product-level depth we can include our Head of Edge Ops.

We have a standing leadership sync at 10:00–10:30 on Tue that can't move. Could we do 10:30–10:50 PT for a compact executive handshake (20 minutes total) — 10 minutes for sponsor context and 10 minutes for the demo? If you need 30 minutes, 11:45–12:15 PT also works for Tom, but that window is riskier.

Either way, please confirm whether your VP-level sponsor can join; if not, having a short, tight demo with Ben as product cover is fine.

Thanks,
Dan
Daniel Olson | Director, Cloud Architecture | Veridian Energy
daniel.olson@veridian.com | +1 (206) 555-4242

Thanks, Daniel —

10:30–10:50 PT works for a compact handshake — I do want to flag that our VP of Product, Markus Klein, is in an all-hands during 10:30–11:30 PT that day and likely can't make the 10:30 start. If the preference is a sponsor presence, can we shift to either 

- Tue Apr 13, 14:30–14:50 PT (VP can join), or
- Tue Apr 13, 11:45–12:05 PT (compromise: Markus can probably step in at 11:45 for 20 minutes)

If you confirm 11:45 we will send an updated invite and a condensed demo script so we keep the session tight. Otherwise Ben will lead at 10:30 and Markus will join the follow-up where needed.

Looping Ben and Rachel to confirm availability; Rachel — can you coordinate the calendar and update the agenda?

Best,
Mina

What we'll do:
